scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test:api: env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" CI=1 NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=postgres://validation:validation@127.0.0.1:1/validation TEST_DATABASE_URL= SESSION_SECRET=validation-only-session-secret pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test
scripts.test:api:integration: test -n "$TEST_DATABASE_URL" || { echo 'Set TEST_DATABASE_URL to a dedicated disposable PostgreSQL test database with the application schema.' >&2; exit 1; }; env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" CI=1 NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL" TEST_DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL" SESSION_SECRET=validation-only-session-secret pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test
scripts.test: pnpm run test:api && pnpm run test:web
scripts.build:artifacts: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && env PORT=19333 BASE_PATH=/ NODE_ENV=production pnpm --filter @workspace/jusoor-program run build
